notes.title: Patch 1.01
notes.notes:
Fixed a few minor issues:

Added a fade transition from the “About Developer” menu to the main menu

Fixed a display bug in the “About Developer” screen on 16:10 aspect ratio

The “Continue” button is now only available after reaching level 2 — this way, the first story beat isn’t skipped and it feels more natural

Thanks a lot to everyone who’s playing! It’s really nice to see more and more people meeting Leo.

notes.title: The full version is out!
notes.notes:
The full version is out!

I still can’t quite believe I’m writing this — this is my first game, and I made it entirely solo. The last few days were especially intense: final translations, builds, bug fixes…

Thank you so much to everyone who wishlisted the game and followed the journey — your support truly kept me going. If you get a chance to play, I’d be incredibly grateful for a review or even just a quick message.

The game is 10% off during launch week. Hope you like it!



Tim

notes.title: Getting Closer to Release!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

I wanted to share a quick update - I’ve been actively working on the game, and as of now, about two-thirds of the levels are complete. The release is getting closer. Just recently, I finished working on a unique level that stands out from the rest of the game.

To be honest, the closer I get to the finish line, the harder it is to believe I’ll actually complete it. That’s why I’ve now set an internal release date for myself. I’m not sharing it publicly just yet — anything can happen - but I’m doing my best to meet it.

I started this project a long time ago, but life kept getting in the way, and it took me a while to really focus. Now I finally feel like I’m on the final stretch, which is also the hardest part. Even though the game is small, it means a lot to me - it’s my first game. Some of you may have already played the demo, and it’s still available!

Sometimes it’s hard to believe that someone else will actually play this game, or that it will really be sold on Steam… but I’m doing everything I can to make that happen. I’m both excited and nervous about that moment. But I’m sure it’s going to be fun.

Thank you so much for following the project!

notes.title: Demo Update: Save System, Level Select & Fixes
notes.notes:
Demo Version Updated!

This update brings a set of improvements to make the experience smoother and more complete:


 Added a save system
 You can now start a new game or continue from where you left off
 Level selection is now available from the main menu
 Checkpoints have been added to tougher sections
 Screen fade-in/out effect added when starting the game
 Several minor bugs fixed


Thanks to everyone who played and shared feedback!
This update makes the demo feel much closer to the final version. Try it out and let me know what you think!

Play demo: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3542470/Leo_The_Square_Demo/

notes.title: Demo Version is Out!
notes.notes:
The demo version of Leo: The Square is now live and open to everyone! 

This demo includes 9 handcrafted levels with a meditative gameplay experience, focusing on platforming mechanics and obstacle-solving. While it doesn’t include story elements yet, it fully represents the core feel of the game. The demo also features atmospheric music and sound design, carefully crafted to match the minimalist aesthetic.

I’d love to hear your thoughts! Your feedback will help improve the final version, so feel free to leave a review or comment on the Steam page. And of course, don’t forget to add the game to your wishlist if you like it!

Try the demo now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3542470/Leo_The_Square_Demo/

Hope you enjoy it!
